claim_policy.all_gates_pass: For crack-detection AUPRC under the tested calibrated degradation and four-tunnel protocol, the MERIT framework effect exceeded the restoration-backbone effect.
claim_policy.always_forbidden: Unqualified dominance across PSNR, perceptual fidelity, width metrology, unseen sites, or all future architectures.
claim_policy.failure: Framework-over-backbone importance is not supported by C051.
claim_policy.framework_only_pass: The framework improved mean AUPRC, but dominance over backbone choice was not established.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

evidence_status: matched retraining on revision-added external tunnels; not prospective result-unseen site confirmation

factorial.paired_initialization: All same-shape parameters are identical at initialization within backbone and seed. The ON prompt channels are zero-initialized while the degraded-image channel matches OFF.
factorial.paired_stream: Within seed, every backbone and arm uses the same frozen clean-patch indices, blur, noise, and per-sample noise seeds.

field_evaluation.aggregation: average paired model/detector seeds within detector-parent, average detectors within parent, average parents within tunnel, then equal-weight the four tunnels
field_evaluation.detector_role: All three are tunnel-held-out D2-trained checkpoints independent of the legacy segmenter used inside the ON training loss.

objective: Test whether the MERIT framework main effect on external four-tunnel crack-detection AUPRC exceeds the maximum restoration-backbone marginal contrast.

prior_result_disclosure.c050: A retrospective 302-parent optical PSNR factorial found a positive MERIT mean effect but framework dominance over backbone was not supported.
prior_result_disclosure.consequence: C051 can support only an endpoint-scoped crack-detection dominance claim; it cannot overturn or hide the C050 PSNR result.
prior_result_disclosure.table5: A prior one-seed single-region controlled experiment showed large ON-OFF detection-recovery contrasts but had no independent replicate or inferential interval.

statistics.backbone_effect: maximum absolute pairwise contrast between backbone marginal means after averaging ON and OFF
statistics.bootstrap: resample physical parents with replacement within each tunnel and recompute every contrast, including the selected maximum backbone contrast

gates.backbone_consistency: all four within-backbone ON-OFF point estimates > 0
gates.detector_consistency: all three detector-family ON-OFF point estimates > 0
gates.tunnel_consistency: at least three of four tunnel ON-OFF point estimates > 0

statistics.secondary_factor_share: framework sum-of-squares divided by backbone sum-of-squares, recomputed in each parent bootstrap; supportive only

training.bundle_interpretation: ON-OFF estimates the complete framework bundle and does not identify the causal contribution of an individual component.
training.checkpoint: fixed final step; no early stopping or result-based checkpoint selection
training.off_control: 1-channel degraded input plus plain L1 loss
training.on_bundle: 3-channel degraded/blur-prompt/noise-prompt input plus L1, gradient, focal-frequency, and frozen legacy segmenter task losses
training.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast; selective scan and losses may promote to float32
